name: Harness Memory
description: Every message: the app lists the Harness Memory notes that match it, and the agent searches further when they fall short.

action.text: Harness Memory notes that match this request are listed below, each with a short snippet only. Before you act, open every one that fits the request with note_get (ids: [12, 15], a list even for one note). When the request reaches an area they do not cover, search with note_search (English keywords, project_path = the repository root), and check script_list before you repeat a command. Notes may be outdated: check them in the code. After you used them, call note_feedback with the ids that helped (ids: [12, 15], or ids: [] when none did). Status lines: "Notes: opened #12, #15" or "Notes: none fit", and "Scripts: ran build-ui" or "Scripts: none fit".
